title: AquaAdvisory
narration: Meet Aqua Advisory: sugarcane irrigation intelligence. This prototype brings farm data, soil moisture prediction, and water balance planning into one practical dashboard.

title: 01 / See the irrigation outlook
narration: Start with the overview. The loaded dataset contains one thousand farms across ten villages. Summary cards show near-term irrigation needs, estimated water demand, and area under advisory. The three-dimensional fleet view and priority list help identify farms needing attention first.

title: 02 / Set the farm context
narration: Open a farm advisory and select a plot. Set the planting date, soil texture, irrigation method, and pump flow. Here we switch from furrow to drip irrigation. Optional probe readings and rainfall inputs let the plan reflect field conditions.

title: 03 / Understand the recommendation
narration: The advisory combines a soil moisture estimate with the F A O fifty-six water balance. It shows the next irrigation date, estimated pump duration, crop water use, and stress status. The water balance chart then projects depletion over fourteen days, making the irrigation trigger and assumptions visible.

title: 04 / Explore the root zone
narration: The crop and soil view connects the recommendation to the root zone. Rotate the soil profile to see available water and the irrigation threshold, alongside crop stage and the crop coefficient curve.

title: 05 / Test a what-if scenario
narration: Next, test a scenario without changing the farm record. Adjust an input, then run the simulator. The comparison shows how predicted moisture, irrigation timing, water volume, and pump hours respond. These are model-based comparisons, not measured field outcomes.

title: 06 / Locate farms across the fleet
narration: The fleet map brings farm priorities into a spatial view. Filter by village or irrigation status, inspect plot boundaries, and switch between two-dimensional mapping and the three-dimensional fleet display. Individual farms remain accessible from the fleet.

title: 07 / Compare village demand
narration: Fleet analytics turns individual plans into a wider demand picture. Compare villages, inspect the fourteen-day demand calendar, and review estimated water volumes and pump hours. The village summary can also be exported for further planning.

title: 08 / Build a pump schedule
narration: Pump scheduling translates demand into operating slots. Choose a village, a planning horizon, and the maximum number of simultaneous pumps. Build the schedule to see feeder load and farm assignments within the configured supply windows. Unmet hours remain visible when the available capacity cannot cover demand.

title: 09 / Make advice accessible
narration: The interface supports English, Kannada, Hindi, and Marathi. Switching language updates the dashboard and advisory text. Read-aloud and export controls make the recommendation easier to communicate and review.

title: 10 / Inspect model reliability
narration: Model Insights separates a strong random holdout score from performance on unseen locations. The report compares random, village, and taluk validation. Geographic generalization is a limitation here, so the displayed results should guide further data collection and field validation.

title: 11 / Keep a person in the loop
narration: The review form lets a field officer, agronomist, or farmer accept, modify, or reject an advisory and add comments. This keeps human judgment in the workflow. No demonstration review is submitted here.

title: From field data to informed irrigation
narration: Aqua Advisory connects prediction, planning, and review. A transparent prototype for irrigation decisions, with every recommendation subject to field confirmation.
